brief:
Israeli occupation authorities are maintaining solitary confinement of Qassam Brigades commander Mhanned Shrim at Gilboa prison amid psychological and physical mistreatment since December 2023, Shehab Wire reported. Warnings have emerged over threats to his life in custody.

The senior Hamas military figure has endured prolonged isolation, a practice applied to other Palestinian prisoners held by Israel, particularly those accused of armed resistance activities.

title: Israeli prison continues isolating Hamas commander Mhanned Shrim
